screens.name: 01-sampler
screens.note: The first App Store screenshot, per the spec's 4.3 note: nineteen pieces at 112 pt, the sampler cloth of small laces in indigo and rose, the hem's days running, and the month as a pricking card with today ringed.

screens.name: 02-win
screens.note: The lift at its last phase, best tier: the pins out and the pricks left, the lace risen with its gold picot edge, the ghost numeral under it, snips frozen mid-fall, the madder headline, and the margin card naming what is waiting.

screens.name: 03-pillow
screens.note: Today's pattern mid-wind on the pillow: the card pinned at -1.2 degrees, the thread with its rings and plaits, the bobbin at the thread's end, THREAD 28 · PICKED OUT ONCE, the plait line and the run marks.

screens.name: 04-book
screens.note: The pattern book: the next card at 76 pt with the ground Mastery chose for it, the chapters by size, the cushion of what playing has earned.

screens.name: 05-first-pattern
screens.note: A first launch's pillow: today's pattern unwound, the brass start pin breathing and the ghost thread showing the first move without a word.

screens.name: 06-paywall
screens.note: Needs -fakeProducts: a scheme's StoreKit configuration is never honoured by a simctl launch. The book art, the pin-head bullets, one payment.

screens.name: 07-workbox
screens.note: The kit's settings on the linen: the pillow's counts, sounds, the reminder, the thread picker once silk is earned.

screens.name: 08-onboarding
screens.note: The first screen anyone sees: LACEWORK between hairlines, the pillow drawn, 'A pattern a day', the pin-head page mark, 'Go on'.

ladder.name: rung-5
ladder.note: Session 5: five by five, both ends pinned, two fifths open — the gimp leads and the puzzle is one fork. Indigo on linen.

ladder.name: rung-51
ladder.note: Session 51: nine by nine, three quarters open, both ends still pinned; the ground chosen by Mastery from the player's record. Gold thread in hand, earned at forty pieces.

ladder.name: rung-150
ladder.note: Session 150: fourteen by fourteen with a window cut in it, as open as can be proved, only the start pinned. Gold thread, picots in the sampler.

ladder.name: rung-500
ladder.note: Session 500: fourteen by fourteen in a ground of windows, neither end pinned — the thread may begin anywhere. The pillow re-covered in indigo ticking.

moments.name: wind
moments.note: The signature interaction, played by the app: fourteen pins wound, each reaching, wrapping and sinking, the bobbin following; a wrong turn and its unpick with the pin springing back up.

moments.name: lift
moments.note: The last three pins and the lift: the thread tightens in a wave, the pins come out, the lace rises with its shadow, the numeral counts, the snips fall, the headline and the margin card arrive.
